title: RESTMO Gear Drive Sprinkler with Metal T-Spike Base,Green | 5 Spray Patterns Rotating Head,Adjustable Spray Range,Lawn Sprinklers for Yard & Garden Plant,Flower Bed&Large Area Watering
features: Heavy Duty Construction – Built to last, designed with high-impact plastic and a zinc alloy metal spike base, this sprinkler is built to withstand harsh weather conditions. Its durable construction ensures long-lasting performance, making it a reliable choice for years of use.

5 Versatile Spray Patterns – Customize your watering needs. Choose from 5 spray patterns—Jet, Flat, Cone, Full, and Vertical—to suit different watering tasks. Whether you need a gentle mist for delicate plants or a powerful stream for large lawns, this sprinkler offers unmatched versatility.

Flexible Coverage – Adjustable spray up to 50 feet in diameter, coverage up to 1,900 sq. ft, this sprinkler provides exceptional coverage for large areas. Simply rotate the adjustment collar to set your desired spray width, ranging from a focused 25° to a full 360° coverage. This flexibility allows you to water specific areas or cover your entire lawn, garden, or yard with ease, ensuring efficient and precise irrigation.

Sturdy Spike Base – Stable and easy to install. The zinc alloy metal spike base ensures stable placement in soil or turf. Simply press it into the ground for a secure fit, allowing for hassle-free setup and reliable operation during use.

Connect Multiple Sprinklers – Expand your watering coverage. Maximize your irrigation efficiency with the ability to connect multiple sprinklers in a series. This flow-through design allows you to link several units together, creating a customized watering system that covers larger areas effortlessly. Perfect for expansive lawns, gardens, or yards, this feature ensures even water distribution without the need to constantly move sprinklers around.
